reference: MAME 0.276 clone, Apollo DN3500, Domain/OS SR10.4 / HP VUE 2.01

evidence.official_mame_behavior: The MAME command-line documentation explains that mouse_device can automatically enable mouse input for systems with mouse controls, and that this may capture the host pointer even when the general mouse option is off.
evidence.change: Updated the clone's mouse-altgr.lua to set mouse=false and mouse_device=none on release; on deliberate left-click recapture it restores mouse_device=mouse and mouse=true. It saves and restores the initial options on emulator stop.
evidence.runtime_update: Loaded version 3 into the existing MAME process without restarting; explicitly left the mouse released.
evidence.host_pointer_check: X11 pointer window PID was 263503 while MAME PID was 274368, consistent with the pointer being outside the MAME window at the time of check.

limits: The screen-wake/activation sequence was not reproduced after this change, so persistence through that trigger still needs direct validation. MAME loaded the script successfully; standalone luac was not installed. The original VM and its configuration remain untouched.
